A highly mobile control Support who masters Primal Lightning to soar freely across the battlefield. |highlight2 = Hero Adjustments |highlight3 = Battlefield Adjustments |highlight4 = System Adjustments |highlight5 = Mode Adjustments |previous=2.1.90 |next= |footnotes= }} '''''From The Designers, ''''' In this patch, we focused on adjusting the strength of some heroes in Brawl to balance their performance in this mode. Additionally, the long-awaited Chaos Clash returns in a revamped form. We've fully upgraded its map, core mechanics, and buff system. Jump in and check it out! In the next patch, we will make balance adjustments based on hero performance in mid-to-late-season ranked matches and pick rates from the recently concluded MSC. Good luck climbing the ranks! =='''I.'''Revamped Hero==

{{HiddenSort|Kaja}}

{{Herobc |hero = Kaja |herotitle = , Nazar King |note = Hero Feature: A highly mobile control Support who masters Primal Lightning to soar freely across the battlefield. |type = Revamp |adjustment = '''Passive''' - {{ai|Kaja|Wings of Lightning}} Kaja's skill damage inflicts [Paralysis] on enemies, briefly slowing them and reducing their damage.

'''Skill 1''' - {{ai|Kaja|Ring of Order}} Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning, dealing damage to enemies while recovering HP.

'''Skill 2''' - {{ai|Kaja|Soaring Wings}} Kaja dashes to the target, dealing damage and knocking them back before entering the [Soaring] state, which reduces this skill's cooldown. Hitting a hero or creep extends the state's duration.

'''Ultimate''' - {{ai|Kaja|Divine Binding}} Kaja hurls a lasso at the target area, restraining enemy heroes within. Can drag to shrink its radius while the skill is active. }} =='''II.'''Hero Adjustments==

{{HiddenSort|Gord}}

{{Herobc |hero = Gord |herotitle = |note = Slightly reduced his early-to-mid-game damage output. |type = nerf |adjustment = '''Passive''' - {{ai|Gord|Mystic Favor}} {{TextID|nerf}} Base Damage: 140 >> 120

'''Ultimate''' - {{ai|Gord|Mystic Gush}} {{TextID|nerf}} Base Damage: 110-210 >> 90-160 }}

{{HiddenSort|Novaria}}

{{Herobc |hero = Novaria |herotitle = |note = We've noticed that Novaria's Skill 2 had too large a gap between average and high-level performance. To address this, we've made it easier to use effectively without lowering its high-end potential. |type = buff |adjustment = '''Skill 2''' - {{ai|Novaria|Astral Recall}} {{TextID|buff}} Movement Speed Boost: 20% initially and 60% after passing through obstacles >> 80% initially, then gradually decays to 30% Base Damage: 230-380 (+90% Total Magic Power) (+ 4% target's Max HP) >> 260-410 (+95% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's Max HP) Max Extra Damage Increase: 150% >> 120% (damage increase per buff stack remains at 15%) }} =='''III.'''Hero Adjustments==

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where using Purify would grant immunity to Clint's skill 1 damage in certain situations. =='''IV.'''System Adjustments== ==='''A.'''Highlight Icons=== When more than 3 match result icons are obtained, they will be collapsed, and only the amount will be displayed. ==='''B.'''Season Achievements=== Added the [Claim All] feature, allowing you to claim multiple task rewards at once. ==='''C.'''Battle Achievement Interface=== Battle Achievements will now be categorized. When multiple Highlight achievements of the same type are obtained, the one with the highest level will be displayed by default. We've added some new match results achievements and adjusted their requirements accordingly. ==='''C.'''Main Interface Clarity Optimizations=== 1. To make the main interface cleaner and more intuitive, we have made the following optimizations. 2. Simplified the status information in the main interface's friend list. 3. Simplified the display of the resource bar at the top of the main interface: ㅤ a. Tickets are no longer displayed. They can now be viewed in the Shop. ㅤ b. When the amount of Gold and the number of owned heroes reach their respective thresholds, the Gold display is collapsed by default but can be expanded manually.
